entities.name: Diuretic hormone P67800
observations: The 44-aa query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Musca domestica diuretic hormone UniProt P67800; matching annotation reports secreted hormone activity regulating Malpighian-tubule fluid secretion and cAMP.

Query sequence has a CRF family Pfam match (PF00473.23) spanning residues 3–44; 44-aa length, predicted mass 5,181.075 Da, and theoretical pI 11.363. These are sequence/tool-derived annotations, not experimental characterization of the query.
